title: Pure vs Impure Functions
description: Pure functions produce new data without side effects; impure functions mutate their arguments, causing different results on repeated calls.

steps.description: Reveal pure_double: list comprehension produces a new list without modifying input.
Reveal impure_double: loop mutates the input list in place.
Reveal first test: pure_double leaves original unchanged, result has doubled values.
Reveal second test: impure_double mutates original, result references the same list.
Reveal surprise: two calls to impure_double double values twice.
Run to show impure_double mutated original.
Run to show data after two impure calls is [4, 8, 12].
